name: CINP 38th World Congress of Neuropsychopharmacology 2028
organizer: Collegium Internationale Neuro-Psychopharmacologicum (International College of Neuropsychopharmacology)
description: CINP announced its next World Congress for June 21 to 24, 2028, in Rio de Janeiro after cancelling the planned 2027 Abu Dhabi congress. No venue or submission deadlines have been published.

deadlines.label: Abstract submission
deadlines.note: estimated from the 2026 cycle (extended deadline January 12, 2026 for a late June congress); not published

sources.note: 2028 congress June 21 to 24, 2028, Rio de Janeiro; no world congress in 2027; Abu Dhabi cancelled
2026 congress June 26 to 29, 2026, Glasgow, joint with SCNP
2026 abstract deadline extended to January 12, 2026, 23:59 CET; notifications February 5, 2026

notes: There is no CINP World Congress in 2027; the college plans regional and educational events instead. Some third party calendars still list a June 2027 Abu Dhabi congress, which CINP states is cancelled.
